LESSON: WRITING 2.4.1 HANDWRITING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Writing 2.4.1 Handwriting
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 2.4.1 Handwriting, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to shape letters well? 2. What do you consider to be a good handwriting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 2.4.1 Handwriting together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration : Ability to write clearly and correctly as the learner write long words forming all ascenders correctly, legibly and

neatly

Values:
Responsibility: Self-drive as the learner practices writing neatly and legibly.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Self-esteem as learners gain skills in writing the letters correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Kenyan Sign Language Activities, Religious Activities, Environmental Activities and Indigenous Language Activities: Good handwriting is integral

in all these learning areas.
